```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

Round() Function:
```{r}
pi = 3.14159
pi_rounded = round(pi)
print(pi_rounded)
```
Round() Function Continued:

```{r}
pi = 3.14159
pi_rounded_2dp = round(pi, digits = 2)
print(pi_rounded_2dp)
```
Rep() Function:

```{r}
rep(5, 10)
#or
print(rep(x=5, times=10))
```
Character, Numerical, and Logical Variables:

```{r}
char = "hello!"
num = 220
log = TRUE

print(char)
print(class(char))

print(num)
print(class(num))

print(log)
print(class(log))
```
Using Variables of Different Types:
```{r}
cell_ID_1 = "CX1"
cell_ID_2 = "CX2"
treated_1 = TRUE
treated_2 = FALSE
num_cells_before_1 = 5415
num_cells_before_2 = 8123
num_cells_after_1 = 1432
num_cells_after_2 = 7543
```

Using Vectors for Variables:
```{r}
cell_IDs = c("CX1", "CX2")
treated_vals = c(TRUE, FALSE)
num_cells_before_vals = c(5415, 8123)
num_cells_after_vals = c(1432, 7543)
```

Using Vectors for Variables Continued:
```{r}
all_my_pets = c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
fourth_pet = all_my_pets[4]
print(fourth_pet)
```
Using the Tibble() Function:
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

radiation_experiment_data = tibble(
  cell_ID = c("CX1", "CX2"),
  treated = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  num_cells_before = c(5415, 8123),
  num_cells_after = c(1432, 7543)
)
```
